name: Storage UOM
definition: The unit in which the material is kept and counted in stock (warehouse, GRN, issue). Stock balances are held in this unit.

name: Consumption UOM
definition: The unit in which the BOM states how much of the material one garment uses (Cons Qty, Final Consumption).
example: Fabric consumed in meter per garment.

name: Purchase UOM
definition: The unit in which the material is bought from the supplier (RMPO, price). When it differs from the Consumption UOM a conversion factor turns the purchase price into the Cons UOM Price.
example: Fabric bought in KG_Nis, consumed in meter: Cons UOM Price = Purchase Price × Conversion Factor.
